info.title: Matomo Reporting API for DBStats plugin

get.description: Gets some general information about this Matomo installation, including the count of websites tracked, the count of users and the total space used by the database.

200.description: Contains the website count, user count and total space used by the database.

get.description: Gets general database info that is not specific to any table.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
